verdict.rationale: Docs show programmatic lifecycle building blocks: CKS API to create/list/update/delete clusters (docs-5), Terraform/OpenTofu IaC for clusters, VPCs, storage, inference (docs-6, docs-28), API access tokens for auth (docs-8, docs-17), kubeconfig for kubectl workload management (docs-7), autoscaling node pools (docs-3), and billing/quota visibility (docs-12, docs-13, docs-34) plus an Inference API for deploying/monitoring inference workloads (docs-19, docs-25). This supports most of an agent-driven create→run→monitor→teardown loop without a human touching the console. missing for 10: no documented MCP server/interface, no single unified 'agent' workflow example, and cluster creation docs foreground the Cloud Console as the primary path with Terraform as an alternative rather than API-first, leaving ambiguity about full console-free operation.
